title: ArcEvents 0.6.2 source loot: finite shared original tables, isolated items and one-time migration
assumptions: Proposed ArcEvents 0.6.2 source-loot rules versus the 0.6.1 generic LOOT grant; source review and analytical expectation, not production activation or measured opening rates. Ninety-three original loot tables retain source rolls, counts, weights and empty/air outcomes; mod items map explicitly to native equivalents.

Low/base/high are modeled sensitivity: 1/5/20 participating accounts, assumed 1/2/4 active hours per player-day, 2/8/32 unique supply openings, 1/3/8 unique ammo openings, and 0.25/1/4 unique armory openings. All modeled participants use this activity; server-wide participation share is unknown. These imply total 3.25/6/11 eligible openings per active hour, not observed throughput.

Ammo uses an explicit assumed 50/50 ammo_tacz/ammo_tacz_2 mix; armory uses an explicit assumed 50/50 armory_chest/armory_chest_tacz mix. Actual generated mix and travel time are unmeasured. Resource and component crates have separate per-opening EV only and are excluded from this requested daily mix.

Every counted opening is a distinct physical shared container eligible for its source-loot-v1 batch. Reopening or a second participant cannot grant again. Additional travel can generate new sites indefinitely; no fixed network item budget or renewable per-container allowance exists. Network-week figures require seven days of new eligible containers.

Every actual table-based container in this comparison was a LOOT marker in 0.6.1, including the armory tables; do not apply the unused CORE guaranteed-gun rule. Each old opening: loose rounds22, cooked beef3.5, actual iron ingots2, gun0.25, vaccine0.2.

Correction to the supplied analysis scope: legacySupplies calls worldFirearmItem without loaded; it defaults to a full configured magazine. The four equally likely default magazines are20/30/8/8, mean16.5 per gun; old LOOT loaded-round EV=0.25*16.5=4.125 per opening. Current source-default configuration is evidence, not verification of deployed overrides. The supplied raw analysis baseline loaded_rounds=0 is not used as actual old behavior.

The new mapper defaults missing GunCurrentAmmoCount to zero. None of the modeled source firearm table entries declares that field, so new loaded-round EV is0; no additional full native magazine is awarded on top of source ammo.

Loose reload units are a potential-use accounting category: tagged native ammo and plain IRON_NUGGET accepted by WorldFirearms each supply one round. They are not an extra item grant. Supplychest has no firearm/direct ammunition entry; its3.5 units are plain nuggets:3.5 expected rolls*(weight4/24)*mean count6. Do not add those same nuggets again under another item category.

Food units count edible item quantity including rotten/negative food, not nutrition, healing, hunger points or saturation. Vaccines are only cure:vaccine mapped medicine-tagged HONEY_BOTTLE. Actual iron ingots and iron blocks stay separate; crafting conversion into nuggets is excluded rather than counted twice. Other original resources, armor, weapons, tools, maps, potions and enchantments are not assigned money values or claimed absent.

Fresh containers receive only source loot. Existing sourceV2 containers may receive one source-loot-v1 batch once while preserving previous items and legacy claims; their unknown count and remaining contents are not added to recurring player-day/network-week totals. Capacity failure consumes no source claim; deterministic planning and a persisted claim prevent reroll/reissue. A crash after claim persistence but before materialization may lose a batch; retry does not duplicate it.

The two physical starter barrels use source supplychest once each and are shared, not a per-account reward. Their actual deterministic seeded contents are not inferred from EV. The existing one-time personal starter kit is unchanged; reentry/resume/migration does not issue a second kit.

The complete native inventory, armor, offhand and XP remain in the expedition journal; exit restores origin and keeps expedition gear isolated. Ender chest and external shop/contract commands are blocked. ArcEvents calls no Vault/tokens/shop/contract payout API. Owned actors are removed before native lethal-death reward callbacks. Other plugins world/proxy hooks remain an integration unknown rather than a measured zero.

Vault and tokens direct before/after mint/burn are individually0. XP and items are separate; no item-to-currency or Vault-to-token exchange rate is assumed. There is no currency price, paid progression, savings target or purchasable full loadout in this change. Current EconomyShopGUI SELL and the owner planned SELL-to-contract transition are unchanged; mode isolation prevents ordinary export, not a global SELL-off.

No additional jobs, contracts, boosts or flight/mining income is stacked with the same expedition hours. Currency ledger totals are context from the parent fresh read-only168h observation, not an ArcEvents attribution, earning-per-hour estimate or proof of isolation. Activity buckets are only a proxy; concentration and unknown callers prevent a typical-income claim.

All loot EVs come from the supplied analytical exact-fraction file; no Monte Carlo simulation or inferred sampling error is used. Decimal amount strings are rounded from exact rational inputs to50 significant digits; evaluate.py uses Decimal arithmetic and checks units/scenario aggregation, not completeness or live behavior. Exact fraction fields are authoritative for repeating expectations.
